tools.name: find_gpus
tools.description: GPUs in stock now on GPYou, worldwide: the cheapest machine per GPU model, GPU count, region and country, cheapest first, with its provider and the data centres or locations it runs in (empty when the provider names only the country). customer_hourly_micro_usd is the price per hour for the whole mac

tools.name: find_prices
tools.description: Inference prices per provider and model, or GPU prices per cloud, on one day (the latest when date is left out), cheapest first: by output price for inference, by hourly price for GPUs. total counts every match; page with limit and offset. Prices are integers: for kind inference, input, output, cach

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: What changed between one day (the latest when date is left out) and the day collected before it: each row is added, removed or changed, with its prices on both days (was, now). Prices are integers: for kind inference, input, output, cache_read and cache_write in millionths of a US dollar per million
